text: ぼくの　とり　ポケモン　そろそろ　もういちど…　たたかわせて　みようか！

structure.jp: ぼくの　とり　ポケモン
そろそろ　もういちど…
たたかわせて　みようか！
structure.en: shall I try letting them battle!

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing たたかう to たたかわせる means making or letting someone else do it. たたかわせて = 'letting them battle'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: たたかわせて　みよう
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means doing it to see how it goes. たたかわせて　みよう = 'I'll try letting them battle'.

patterns.name: 〜ようか
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form plus か is the speaker asking himself 'shall I?'. みようか = 'shall I give it a try?'.
